metadata.title: SSPP – Secure DNS Platform
metadata.remarks: System Security & Privacy Plan template asserting institutional requirements for authoritative, resilient, and observable DNS as a platform trust dependency.

import-profile.remarks: Imports institutional baseline security, governance, and resiliency requirements applicable to all platform infrastructure services.

system-characteristics.system-description: Authoritative DNS platform service providing deterministic name resolution, controlled recursion, bounded caching, segmentation through zoning and views, resilience under failure, and security-relevant observability for institutional systems.

props.name: platform-capability
props.remarks: This SSPP asserts the Secure-DNS composite trust pattern.

props.name: governance-scope
props.remarks: DNS is provided as a governed platform dependency consumed by identity, security, and application services.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Secure-DNS assumes DNS resolvers and authoritative services are hosted on infrastructure meeting Secure-Server platform trust requirements.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Where DNS services are hosted in cloud-managed environments, Secure-DNS assumes compliance with Trusted-Cloud platform trust requirements.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Secure-DNS relies on authoritative and bounded platform time to enforce TTL semantics, cache freshness, and time-based trust guarantees.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Secure-DNS assumes DNS queries and resolver communication traverse networks that enforce integrity, isolation, and routing correctness as defined by Secure-Networking.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: DNS telemetry and audit signals are assumed to be transported, stored, and protected by a trusted logging and monitoring platform.

system-implementation.remarks: This SSPP asserts Secure-DNS by composition of platform DNS patterns. It defines no independent controls; compliance is achieved through satisfaction of referenced patterns.

components.title: Secure DNS (Composite Assertion)
components.description: Composite assertion that DNS behavior is authoritative, deterministic, bounded, resilient, observable, and governed.

roles.title: DNS Governance Authority
roles.remarks: Defines institutional posture, risk tolerance, and survivability expectations for DNS as a platform trust dependency.

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: Executive Cyber Leadership per NIST NICE Framework (SP 800-181).

roles.title: DNS Platform Architect
roles.remarks: Designs DNS architecture, dependency relationships, zoning strategy, and integration with Secure Time and other platform services.

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: Security Architect per NIST NICE Framework.

roles.title: DNS Platform Operations
roles.remarks: Operates DNS resolvers, authoritative services, caching behavior, and availability mechanisms in accordance with defined patterns.

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: Systems Administrator per NIST NICE Framework.

roles.title: DNS Security Monitoring and Assurance
roles.remarks: Monitors DNS telemetry, detects trust degradation, supports investigation, and contributes to assurance and resiliency assessment.

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: Security Operations Analyst per NIST NICE Framework.

control-implementation.remarks: Control satisfaction is achieved through inherited control implementations in Secure-DNS constituent patterns. This SSPP introduces no standalone controls or compensating measures.
